text.description_html:
Falcon SC71AL, ADA Compliant Full Cover Heavy Duty Door Closer

The Grade 1 Falcon SC71AL is a heavy duty closer that is built for busy commercial applications. Designed for use with aluminum storefronts, the Falcon SC71AL Doromatic Closer is ADA compliant and deliver tough performance. It has a 6-3/4” x 2-3/8” mounting hole pattern.

Specifications and Features for the Falcon SC71AL Commercial Door Closer:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Single piece cast aluminum body
  • Closer Body Length: 13-5/8"
  • 6-3/4” x 2-3/8” mounting hole pattern.
  • 1 1/2" diameter piston
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved (UL Listed 63Z0)
  • Spring Size: 1-6
  • ADA Compliant
  • 10 Year Warranty
  • SC71AL Dimensions (PDF)

The Falcon SC71AL is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior or exterior doors.
